design_direction.summary: A clean, polished, kid-friendly science brand using a dark-blue atom as the hero symbol. Colourful accents should support the layout, not dominate it.
design_direction.audience: Kids around 10 years old and their parents
design_direction.layout_rule: Hero section must use a two-column layout on desktop: text left, atom illustration right. On mobile, stack text first, illustration second.

fonts.heading: Nunito, Baloo 2, Arial Rounded MT Bold, sans-serif
